title: Olist E-Commerce Analytics Dashboard
description: E-commerce reporting solution to monitor sales performance, delivery issues, and customer behavior across nearly 100K orders. Used PostgreSQL and SQL for reporting views, then Power BI and DAX for modeling, KPIs, and dashboarding.

title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis on 22M Google Reviews
description: NLP system for identifying which aspects of a business drive positive and negative customer sentiment. Built NLP pipelines using weak supervision and compared TF-IDF, fine-tuned RoBERTa, and GPT-4.1-mini against manually labeled ground truth.

title: Predicting Major US Power Outage Severity
description: Predictive model for classifying outages likely to become severe and supporting earlier prioritization of high-risk events. Used LightGBM with engineered outage, climate, geographic, and grid features, along with missingness analysis and statistical testing.

title: Recommendation System for Amazon Sports & Outdoor Products
description: Personalized recommendation system for ranking products in a highly sparse customer-review environment. Engineered user- and item-level features and compared SVD, Ridge, and hybrid approaches across 4M+ Amazon reviews to generate top-10 recommendations.

title: The Hidden Shape of Recessions: Industry Declines & Recoveries 1995–2024
description: Interactive explorable explanation comparing job losses and recovery patterns across industries during the 2001, 2008, and 2020 U.S. recessions using D3.js.

title: Boston Bike Traffic
description: Interactive map of Boston cycling traffic built with D3.js and Mapbox, highlighting hourly patterns and location-based differences across the city.

title: Mapping Misconduct: NYPD Complaint Trends (1985–2019)
description: Interactive visualization of NYC civilian complaints (1985–2019) using D3.js, exploring spatial and temporal patterns of police misconduct.

title: Complaints Surge Among Young Officers
description: Two contrasting visualizations built from the same NYPD complaint data to demonstrate how design and framing can shape interpretation and narrative.

title: Portfolio
description: A growing data science portfolio showcasing analytical, visualization, and research projects developed during graduate study and beyond.

title: NYC Yellow Taxi Fare Prediction
description: Fare prediction system for estimating NYC taxi prices from trip characteristics such as distance, duration, tolls, and time of day. Processed 150M+ rides with Apache Spark and trained LightGBM on engineered trip features.

title: Quarterback Salary Analysis
description: Exploratory analysis of NFL quarterback salaries and team performance, using clustering and visual analytics to examine how pay levels relate to win percentage.

title: Car Value Predictor
description: Vehicle pricing tool for estimating market value from make, model, year, mileage, trim, and other listing attributes. Scraped vehicle listings and compared XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost before deploying the final model in an interactive dashboard.
